title: Production authority: sealed SSC module deployments
summary: For a production release represented in current SSC, Deployment consumes a QUALIFIED module deployment as an immutable fixed point. It traverses exact ssc_deployment_dependency ids, verifies deployment manifest authority, obtains source.get_deployment_package/getDeploymentPackage exact materialisation, and rejects floating development package semantics.
invariants: Root and every transitive dependency deployment must be QUALIFIED and carry immutable manifest authority.
Exact dependency deployment ids are semantic release authority; Deployment never substitutes newer qualified dependencies.
Deployment consumes SSC services rather than querying or recreating SSC persistence semantics.
getDeploymentPackage must report sealed-deployment-exact-closure for release deployment.
Every returned semantic object/resource must be attributable to the exact reachable sealed deployment set.
Development source.get_package/latest-accepted resolution is not an acceptable substitute for an already sealed release.

provenance.claim: Defines sealed SSC production authority and service boundary.
Candidate adapter validates qualified exact sealed dependency closure through injected SSC services.
Current SSC exact deployment dependency authority.
